packageRules.description: Group the Next.js runtime so React and Next never land on mismatched majors in separate PRs.
Group Tailwind with its PostCSS plugin — their versions are lockstep.
Patch and minor updates to dev tooling are safe to batch and auto-merge once CI gates exist (WP6).
shadcn components are copied in, not consumed from the package. The package is only the CLI and the tailwind.css import, so its updates need a human reading the changelog.
TypeScript majors change what compiles. Never batch or auto-merge one.
